## 1) Module autopilot: run + select best
```bash

  --registry experiment_system/config/module_registry.yaml \
  --run --select-best
```

- Executes registered module experiments from `module_registry.yaml`
- Compares against the current champion (`baseline/champion_v5_latest.json`)
- If something beats the champion under your criteria, it should promote/select it as best (depending on how your tool is implemented)

After it finishes, check:
- Which module (if any) was selected
- Whether it wrote an updated champion or a selection artifact (often in `baseline/` or `baseline/reports/`)

## 2) System autopilot: run system candidates
```bash
python3 experiment_system/tools/system_autopilot.py \
  --spec experiment_system/config/system_candidates.yaml \
  --run
```
What it does:
- Runs end-to-end/system variants listed in `system_candidates.yaml`
- Produces a system-level comparison report

After it finishes, verify:
- Any candidate surpasses the champion on your primary metric(s)
- Whether results are “PASS/FAIL/INCONCLUSIVE” per your harness

## 3) Generate the next fix plan
